srList.sentence: Material and Methods The study population included patients with the following conditions who were managed at Mie Prefectural General Medical Center; unidentified clinical syndrome, (UCS; n = 98), infectious disease (n = 184), acute cerebral infarction (ACI; n = 130) hematological malignancy (n = 23), acute coronary syndrome (ACS; n = 40) solid cancer (n = 68), peripheral arterial and venous thromboembolism (PAVTE; n = 34) and DIC (n = 81).

srList.sentence: The significance of differences between groups was examined using the Mann-Whitney U-test.
